rules.sentence: In bivariate analysis with binary logistic regression model length of hospital stay, previous history of abdominal surgery, previous history of intestinal obstruction and also the type of intestinal obstruction were associated with the management outcomes of IO in the study population at a p value of 0.25.

For these above-mentioned factors, multivariate analysis in binary logistic regression model was done and we found out that there was significant association (p<0.05) between the management outcomes of intestinal obstruction and 3 of them; these were length of hospital stay, previous history of abdominal surgery and previous history of intestinal obstruction (Table 6).
